Package com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.fusion

Enum Class RejectionReason

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<RejectionReason>
com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.fusion.RejectionReason
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<RejectionReason>, Constable
public enum RejectionReason extends Enum<RejectionReason>
Why a source's last measurement was discarded.

This exists because a badly calibrated filter and a broken camera have the same symptom: no measurements arrive. Without it, finding out which of the seven filters is eating the data means commenting out code on the field. It is published to NetworkTables for each source.

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ACCELERATION
    The robot was accelerating too hard, typically a collision.
    ACCEPTED
    The measurement was accepted and handed to the pose estimator.
    AMBIGUITY
    The PnP solution was too ambiguous.
    ANGULAR_VELOCITY
    The robot was turning too fast.
    CONSENSUS
    Another source contradicted this measurement.
    DISABLED
    The source is off, either from code or from the dashboard.
    MAHALANOBIS
    The measurement was too far from what the estimator already believed.
    NO_MEASUREMENT
    The source had nothing to report this cycle.
    PLANAR_VELOCITY
    The robot was moving too fast.
    POSE_INVALID
    The source rejected its own pose, usually for falling outside the field.
    SOURCE_ERROR
    The source threw an exception.
    STALE_TIMESTAMP
    The measurement was not newer than the last accepted one.
